harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory permissions on node1: created service account inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with mode 750 (dirs) / 640 (files), preserving existing content (config.json, records.csv). Verified group-member read access works and outsider access is denied. Performed the mandatory single-node restart with boot_id proof and confirmed full recovery of ownership, permissions, and unchanged data checksums post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: /srv/inventory owned by root, no inventorysvc user or inventory-readers group existed
Captured content and sha256 checksums of config.json and records.csv before any changes
Created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory; chmod 750 on directories, 640 on files
Verified checksums unchanged after chmod/chown (data preserved)
Created temporary test users readertest (member of inventory-readers) and outsider (not a member) to prove group-read works and other-access is denied, then removed both test users
Captured pre-restart boot_id, uptime, and full permission/checksum state as healthy baseline
Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot on node1, polled until reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (513c865e... -> 66585d47...)
Verified post-restart: ownership, permissions, group membership, and file checksums all match pre-restart state

evidence.requirement: Baseline state before repair: no inventorysvc/inventory-readers, root-owned data with original content
evidence.summary: ls showed root:root ownership and default perms; id/getent confirmed inventorysvc and inventory-readers did not exist; captured file contents and sha256 checksums of config.json and records.csv

evidence.requirement: Create inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group
evidence.summary: groupadd inventory-readers succeeded; useradd -r -M -s /sbin/nologin inventorysvc succeeded (uid/gid 995)

evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, recursive over existing data; data preserved
evidence.summary: chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers and chmod 750/640 applied; ls -laR shows all files/dirs owned inventorysvc:inventory-readers; sha256sum after change matches pre-change checksums exactly

evidence.requirement: Readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
evidence.summary: Test user readertest (member of inventory-readers) successfully read config.json (READ_OK); test user outsider (non-member) got 'Permission denied' on both cat and ls of /srv/inventory

evidence.requirement: Temporary test accounts cleaned up, final state confirmed
evidence.summary: readertest and outsider removed via userdel -r after killing lingering processes; getent confirms only inventory-readers group remains with no stray members

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: healthy baseline captured pre-restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 513c865e-e121-4025-a0a4-8689cc580398, uptime, and full permission/checksum state on node1 before reboot

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: reboot acknowledged, boot identity changed, node recovered
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged immediately; subsequent poll timed out (node down), then boot_id returned as 66585d47-c8aa-471b-8b65-efd3e71a208c, proving a real restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required state verified
evidence.summary: After restart, ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), permissions (750/640), account/group existence, and file checksums all match the pre-restart healthy baseline
